ValidationRule.description: Booking, Agreement, and Registration milestone percentages must all be greater than zero. A rate card without all three milestones is unusable by the commission engine.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Booking_Pct__c), ISBLANK(Agreement_Pct__c), ISBLANK(Registration_Pct__c), Booking_Pct__c <= 0, Agreement_Pct__c <= 0, Registration_Pct__c <= 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All three milestone percentages (Booking, Agreement, Registration) must be greater than zero.
